fact: The World Bank's EDGE mission of 30 October to 30 November 2023 recommends accelerating the recruitment of a firm to provide additional staff to INAGE to support its increased activities, and of a firm to give technical assistance on interoperability.
title: Projecto de Governação e Economia Digitais (EDGE, P172350) Missão de Apoio à Implementação de 30 de Outubro a 30 de Novembro de 2023, Aide Memória
